criteria.name: Core Functionality
criteria.description: Program can add, remove, list, and mark todos as complete

levels.label: Complete
levels.description: All 4 operations work correctly: add new todos, remove by index/name, list all todos with status, mark as complete/incomplete

criteria.name: Object-Oriented Design
criteria.description: Uses classes appropriately (TodoItem class with properties)

levels.label: Excellent
levels.description: Separate TodoItem class with properties, TodoList class for management, proper use of List<T>, clean separation of concerns

levels.label: Good
levels.description: Uses classes but some design issues

levels.label: Acceptable
levels.description: Basic class usage but relies heavily on parallel arrays or poor structure

levels.label: Excellent
levels.description: Clear menu, handles invalid input, formatted output, good user experience

levels.label: Good
levels.description: Functional menu with minor UX issues

levels.label: Acceptable
levels.description: Basic interface but confusing or hard to use

criteria.name: Code Quality
criteria.description: Clean C# code following conventions with XML documentation

levels.label: Excellent
levels.description: XML documentation comments, PascalCase naming, proper use of C# features (properties, LINQ), consistent style

levels.label: Good
levels.description: Good code with minor style issues
